candidates.author: Brien Lundin
candidates.text:
You know better than me, my friend. I do know that the junior mining stocks were on fire and I was making more money, more quickly, than at any other point in my career. 

And that was a very weird feeling when just about every other aspect of my life had been tossed in the air.
